sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 310. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Encouragement (continuous buff that renews the effect "fills the Unison gauge by 5" every 10 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
